fields.value: Tall and on a larger scale than Elizabeth; graceful, though shy rather than commanding.
Gentle, affectionate, accomplished, reserved, and initially timid with strangers.
To please her brother, welcome Elizabeth, and recover confidence after Wickham’s attempted exploitation.
Darcy’s much younger sister, orphaned and under the guardianship of Darcy and Colonel Fitzwilliam; heiress to thirty thousand pounds.
About sixteen when Elizabeth meets her; fifteen during the attempted Ramsgate elopement.
Gentlewoman and heiress; no paid occupation.
Reveals Darcy’s tenderness and provides living evidence against Wickham’s account.
Younger sister and ward of Darcy; niece of Lady Catherine.
Moves from the shadow of Wickham’s manipulation toward a warm sisterly bond with Elizabeth.
Darcy: devoted brother and guardian. Elizabeth: admired future sister. Wickham: former manipulator in a failed elopement scheme.
Chapter 35 in Darcy’s account; appears onstage in Chapter 44.
